conclusion: Detached compact organic top contacts should be removed only when they have no geometric bearing to support bodies or previously supported interfaces. Keep complete long contacts and supported short contacts. Evaluate bearing with centerline segment distances, and construct segment AABBs by merging both endpoints: BoundingBox(pmin, pmax) rejects reversed segments and can falsely classify a supported contact as detached. Direct segment checks avoid repeated polygon-offset work. Combined with the direct ordinary/sharp-tail contact algorithm, this removed all five demonstrated detached qq fragments while preserving exact support coverage, eliminated long closed rings, preserved test2 at 115 support paths and 56 interfaces with complete 21.399 mm and 21.418 mm bottom outlines, and kept the earlier model at 1414 support paths and 858 interface paths with interface paths identical to the verified bearing implementation.
